sql: SELECT ticker, kind, premium, summary, d['stance']['answer'] AS stance, d['stance']['confidence'] AS stance_sure, d['conviction']['answer'] AS conviction, d['urgent']['value'] AS urgency FROM (SELECT ticker, kind, premium, summary, prompt_jev(summary, '{"stance":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Which way is this options print leaning?","criteria":{"bullish":"Calls bought on the ask, or puts sold on the bid. The buyer wants the underlying higher.","bearish":"Puts bought on the ask, or calls sold on the bid. The buyer wants the underlying lower.","neutral":"Hedging, spreads, or a print with no clear directional intent."}},"conviction":{"type":"score","instructions":"How much conviction does this single print show, judging by premium, volume against open interest, and whether it swept.","criteria":["routine","notable","aggressive"]},"urgent":{"type":"noul","instructions":"A trader watching this name should be told about this print right now."}}') AS d FROM silver_flow)
